name: ai-google-maps-email-extractor
title: AI Google Maps Email Extractor | Business Contact Emails
description:
Scrape Google Maps business listings and extract a public contact email from each business's own website. Returns structured leads with name, address, rating, phone, website, and email.

INPUT: a single natural-language string describing the businesses you want contact emails for.

Example input:
{"query": "roofing contractors in Dallas with emails"}

Example output (one dataset item):
{"name": "T Rock Roofing", "address": "9330 LBJ Fwy #900, Dallas, TX 75243", "rating": 4.9, "phone": "+1 469-931-9867", "website": "https://www.dallasroofer.com", "email": "info@dallasroofer.com"}

HOW IT WORKS (honestly): We pull the email address directly from each business's own website (homepage or contact page), the same one a visitor would see. We do not guess emails, do not verify deliverability, and do not use any private or enrichment data source. Not every business lists a public email, so result counts will be lower than a pure business-search run. Only leads with a found email are returned and billed.

Use cases: B2B cold email prospecting, contractor lead generation, sales outreach, partner outreach. Works best with service businesses (roofers, plumbers, electricians, HVAC, dentists, law firms) that maintain a real website with a contact page.
